strings.title: Chemotaxis
strings.boardTitle: Find a nutrient streak around the walls.
strings.strainHelp: The enhanced cell responds more strongly to local nutrient gradients. It can still miss the direction you want.
strings.boardLabel: Hexagonal board. Orange dots are nutrients, hatching marks depletion, minus signs mark repellents, and crosses mark walls.
strings.mapHint: Tap terrain for rules. Tap a lit tile to preview; double-tap to execute the whole run.
strings.welcomeBody: Tap to roll and move directly on the board. Bridge one empty tile to keep a chain. Reach the goal to double feeding points.
strings.lesson1Body: First learn a direction: roll, then choose 1 → for an orange nutrient. These three introductory moves use single steps.
strings.lesson2Body: Choose 1 → again for a second nutrient. Consecutive nutrients are worth more points.
strings.lesson3Title: 3 · A plan can meet bad luck
strings.lesson3Body: There is another nutrient ahead, but these demonstration dice have no 1 →. Choose another direction and experience a broken Combo.
strings.lessonDoneBody: You have tried full runs, chain grace, chain breaks, refuelling and goal doubling. Live games use real probabilities. Tap terrain for its rules. Tutorial scores are not ranked.
strings.lessonNote: Tutorial dice are scripted; movement and scoring follow live rules. Tutorial scores are not ranked.
strings.readyTitle: Chase the streak, or make progress?
strings.chooseHint: Use matching faces together. One foodless tile keeps the chain; two break it. Fresh food at landing refuels without a collision, up to 3 actions per turn.
strings.stuck: None of these directions is open. Tumble in place and roll again next turn.
strings.remaining: {count} hexes to goal, before wall detours
strings.probabilityNote: Shown odds apply before repellent cancellation, which prioritises inward dice. The locked depleted die draws no direction; all other dice are independent.
strings.event_start: Head for the goal and connect nutrients along your route.
strings.event_break: Two foodless tiles. The chain ends.
strings.event_moved: Move complete. Choose again next roll.
strings.event_wait: Tumbled in place. Try a new direction next turn.
strings.event_lost: No turns left. This journey ends here.
strings.comboBroken: Two foodless tiles ended the previous chain.
strings.nearGoal: Watch your remaining turns. The flag doubles feeding points.
strings.resultScience: This board makes environment-influenced random movement playable. Dice counts and Combos are game rules, not a quantitative model of real bacteria.
strings.unlock: Enhanced cell unlocked. Try it in your next game.
strings.feedback: Did this game make it easier to understand how the environment affects cell movement?
strings.storageFail: Browser storage is unavailable. You can still export this run.
strings.localOnly: Your nickname, score and optional feedback stay on this device. Nothing is uploaded.
strings.noRecords: No records for this map yet.
strings.localGroup: Ranked by rules version, map seed and size, and cell type
strings.confirmBody: This unsaved run will be cleared. Saved scores will remain.
strings.ruleGoal: Reach the flag within the turn budget. Chains raise each nutrient’s value; finishing doubles feeding points. Chasing too far can leave too few turns to finish.
strings.ruleDice: Start with 3 dice. Rich zones add 1. Depletion locks 1 to stay. Repellent zones roll 3, then cancel the die whose next tile increases repulsion most; if all point outward, cancel the smallest decrease. Other matching dice remain valid. Displayed odds are per die before cancellation.
strings.ruleMove: Matching dice must be used together: two 2s mean two steps in direction 2. Walls and edges stop the run and end the turn. When ALL directions are blocked, retry once per turn for free. If still blocked, wait one turn. Retries keep the same probabilities.
strings.ruleCombo: Collect each nutrient once. Chain rewards are +10, +25, +40, +55… points, increasing by 15 each time. One foodless tile between nutrients is allowed; two break the chain. Waiting also breaks it. Ending on new food without a collision grants another roll, up to 3 actions per turn.
strings.ruleFinish: Reach the goal to end the game: feeding points ×2, plus 5 per spare turn. Without a finish, keep feeding points. The goal does not alter dice probabilities.
strings.ruleMeaning: The board translates random motion and environmental influence into game rules. Locked dice, nutrient chains and finishing multipliers are game mechanics, not quantitative bacterial behaviour.
strings.languageHelp: Like the questionnaire, this game uses separate JSON language packs. Switching preserves your game. Imported packs last for this page session only.
strings.languageInvalid: This language pack is incomplete or invalid. Your current language was kept.
strings.kbd: Keyboard: Space to roll; 1–6 to use a matching-face group.
strings.event_refuel: Collected {count} nutrients! Roll again in the same turn.
strings.event_collision: Hit a wall or edge. Stopped before it; this turn ends.
strings.seedHelp: The same seed and size produce the same map. Dice rolls are randomized afresh.
strings.dragMap: Drag when zoomed · pinch to zoom · wheel to pan
strings.ruleWorld: First, randomly place the start, goal and environment cores. Then run a cellular automaton for five generations, using each tile's six neighbours, and check that the start and goal are connected. Terrain stays fixed during play; nutrients can still be consumed.
strings.proceduralTitle: Read the terrain. Find your next Combo.
strings.reviewTip: Check where the whole dice group lands before taking a food detour.
strings.reviewCombo: You linked a chain of nutrients. Next time, balance that chain with time to reach the goal.
strings.reviewEscape: You escaped a depleted or repellent area and regained more direction dice.
strings.previewPrompt: Choose a direction to preview the route.
strings.previewBreak: the previous chain breaks en route
strings.rescueHelp: All directions are blocked. Retry once this turn for free; the next roll is still random.
strings.event_rescue: Free retry used. If all directions are still blocked, wait one turn.
strings.fullscreenUnavailable: Full screen is unavailable in this browser. The board fills the available screen; browser controls may let you hide the toolbar.
strings.boardRollHint: Roll {count} direction dice. Matching faces move together.
strings.boardChooseHint: Choose a route on the board
strings.perDieProbability: Number → direction · odds change by region
strings.wallExample: Stop before the wall · your turn ends
strings.fieldProbabilityHint: Zone sets dice count · nearby food and repellents change direction odds
strings.demoProbability: Scripted tutorial dice · live games use the displayed odds
strings.directMoveHint: Tap a lit tile to preview · double-click / double-tap to move
strings.tutorialRollHint: Tap the dice, then follow the highlighted route.
strings.guideIntro: Dice offer directions. Read the whole board and choose a route. Matching dice must be used together.
strings.guide_roll_body: Lift and release the dice, tap, or press Space. Start with 3. Rich zones add 1, depletion locks 1, and repulsion cancels the most inward die.
strings.guide_choose_body: Tap any lit route tile to preview the full move and score. Double-click or double-tap that tile to move, or use Confirm.
strings.guide_repeat_body: One foodless tile preserves a chain; two break it. Longer chains earn more per nutrient. Reach the goal to double all feeding points.
strings.zonePriority: Overlapping zones resolve as repellent → rich → depleted → normal. Eating food recalculates nearby zones. Walls block movement only. Each die is independent; percentages refer to one die, not the chance of seeing a face at least once in a roll.
strings.explain_cell: The cell marks your position. After rolling, move in an offered direction; unoffered routes are unavailable.
strings.explain_nutrient: Collected when crossed, once per tile. Chain rewards are 10, 25, 40, 55… points. End on new food without a collision to roll again, up to 3 actions per turn.
strings.explain_rich: Uneaten food and immediate neighbours form a rich zone: 3 base dice plus 1 bonus, all usable. More distant food may slightly affect direction odds.
strings.explain_empty: Passable, with no food points. A chain survives one foodless tile, but breaks after two. Background colour shows the current environmental zone.
strings.explain_depleted: One of the 3 base dice is locked to stay, leaving 2 mobile dice and fewer escape choices. Each depleted roll locks one die; leaving the zone removes the lock. Locked dice never add movement.
strings.explain_consumed: Cannot be collected again. With no fresh food nearby, the zone may become depleted. Crossing it again counts as a foodless step.
strings.explain_repellent: The node and its neighbours form a repellent zone. Roll 3 dice using environmental odds, then compare each die’s next tile: cancel the die with the largest increase in repulsion. If all head outward, cancel the smallest decrease. Only the crossed-out die is ignored; matching dice remain usable.
strings.explain_wall: Impassable. A run stops before a wall or edge and ends the turn without refuelling. Blocked directions can still be rolled.
strings.explain_goal: Arriving ends the game even mid-run. Feeding points ×2, plus 5 per spare turn. If time runs out, you keep feeding points.
strings.tableLesson1Title: Meet your cell. Find its first nutrient.
strings.tableLesson1Body: The cell is your piece, the flag is the goal, amber dots are food. Tap the dice, then double-tap the lit tile to the right: +10 points and another roll.
strings.tableLesson2Body: Two 1 → faces mean a two-tile run. Tap a lit tile to preview, then double-tap to move: the next nutrients earn +25 and +40.
strings.tableLesson3Title: One empty tile keeps the chain.
strings.tableLesson3Body: A repellent node affects this tile. Roll 3 dice; the crossed-out one is cancelled. Move 2 ↘ to an empty tile: the chain stays, but the next tile must contain food.
strings.tableLesson4Title: A second foodless tile breaks it.
strings.tableLesson4Body: Use both 6 ↗ dice. The first empty tile ends the old chain; food at the landing starts a new one. Preview shows the whole outcome.
strings.tableLesson5Title: Food changes the field and refuels.
strings.tableLesson5Body: Fresh food nearby restores 4 dice. Move 2 ↘ to another nutrient. Watch the zone readout and chain banner. A turn allows at most 3 actions.
strings.tableLesson6Title: A locked die. One last move.
strings.tableLesson6Body: This tile is depleted: 1 of the 3 base dice locks, while two 1 → dice remain usable. Move the whole group; the flag stops the run and doubles feeding points. Leaving depletion removes the lock.
strings.repelEffect: 3 base dice · cancel the one heading furthest inward
strings.normalEffect: 3 base dice · nearby signals change direction odds
strings.richEffect: 3 base + 1 bonus · all 4 dice can move
strings.cancelReason: One direction-{face} die was cancelled: most inward first, or weakest escape if all point outward.
strings.tossHint: Lift and release to roll · or tap
strings.tableInvitation: The dice are yours. Roll, then choose a route on the board.
strings.tableChooseHint: Touch a die, or a lit tile
strings.tapAgainHint: Double-click / double-tap a lit tile to move
